ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast white contiguous blob located at the superior center adjacent to the median notch; the majority of the fluke surface is characterized by a uniform low-intensity dark field with minor high-intensity speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 45 degrees relative to the lobe's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low pixel-amplitude variations along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes; right lobe shows more pronounced peaks than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to the superior edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization are localized at the distal tips (lobes' extremities) of both the left and right flukes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle encrustations visible at the distal tips; significant focal white depigmentation concentrated at the superior central margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Scattered low-density white spotting across the primary dark-intensity surface area.
